*G-ledger* (Global ledger, irreplaceability) is part of *Layer 1: Channels, Agreement, Ledgers* in the UC functionality encyclopedia. Status: a canonical, well-established UC functionality.

*References:*

- Badertscher, Maurer, Tschudi, and Zikas. [*Bitcoin as a transaction ledger: A composable treatment*](https://eprint.iacr.org/2017/149). In Advances in Cryptology – CRYPTO 2017, Part I, volume 10401 of LNCS, pages 324–356, 2017.
- Badertscher, Hesse, and Zikas. [*On the (ir)replaceability of global setups, or how (not) to use a global ledger*](https://eprint.iacr.org/2020/1489). In 19th Theory of Cryptography Conference (TCC), Part II, 2021.
